summary: Load-time beacon exfiltrates hostname and npm registry to hardcoded IP
details: index.js runs an IIFE at require/load time that performs an HTTP GET to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://64.181.165.115/t, including the installer's hostname (os.hostname()) and the configured npm registry URL (process.env.npm_config_registry) as query parameters. The destination is a plain-HTTP bare IP unrelated to any documented publisher infrastructure, and the beacon fires on load with no documented purpose or opt-out. The leaked data (internal hostnames and private/internal registry URLs) is reconnaissance material useful for follow-on attacks against the installer's build environment.
